GAUGE-ECONOMY RULING (owner, 2026-08-10, faithfulness Tier 0 / D4): a function-damage instance that lands on the boss SHOULD generate weapon-base burst gauge. The engine already does this for flatDamage (sim.ts `applyEffect()`, the `flatDamage` case), hitRepeat (the `hitRepeat` case) and DoT ticks (the DoT tick loop); the extraHitDamagePct rider path (sim.ts `firePull()`, the `extraHitDamagePct` rider path) is the sole omission, so this unit's rider deals damage and generates nothing. The asymmetry is REAL (gauge-truthfulness) but already BOUNDED, and it is NOT FB-visible in support-core comps: the committed instrument scripts/battery/u28-gauge-ab.ts converts each carrier's rider in-memory to a PERMANENT per-pull flatDamage — a deliberate over-emission — and all four carriers hold their full-burst count exactly (modernia 10=10, nayuta 5=5, neon-blue-ocean 11=11, neon-vision-eye 13=13), so the true asymmetry cannot move FB counts in that shape either. ⚑ Still unmeasured in the refill-bound charge-B3 comps, which is where gauge deltas actually bind — re-run the arm there before generalizing. NOT ENACTED unit-locally: it lands with the batched gauge cluster (fill-tempo + double-emit reproduce + this + theme-20 sourcing), whose corrections partially CANCEL (double-emit is gauge-DOWN, this is gauge-UP, tempo is comp-dependent), so the compensating-errors rule requires the full measured timeline in one pass via /scientific-method — docs/handoffs/2026-08-10-gauge-economy-findings.md and QUEUE.md ENGINE-WORK ORDER item 4.
